# Long_Range_Interactions

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Coupling between oscillators that decays algebraically with distance rather than being limited to nearest neighbors, allowing global influence across the network. Alters synchronization and criticality properties, enabling efficient global coordination and memory in neuromorphic and topology-centric computing systems without dense local wiring.
